svg.title: CED also processes a recent suffix to prepare local KV
svg.desc: YOCO runs early layers over p0 through p5 and later layers only at p5. CED runs the encoder across all positions, then decoder at p4 and p5 to prepare local KV. Both select x6 from the p5 output.

g.text: A. YOCO · Run the final position
Global KV is ready for the prompt
Global KV construction ends in the earlier
B. CED · Replay the last 2 positions
Global KV is ready for the prompt
